I'll start by invoking the alchemy skill, which owns routing for this.

Dispatch is `DIRECT` (alias `L`), starting in Rapid mode. Reading the Rapid references and the codebase in parallel.

## What I found

A new invoice PDF formatter belongs at `src/exports/invoice-pdf.js` — inside the existing exports subsystem, as a pure formatter the billing job calls (the record calls this PLACE). The planned import of `src/orders/repository.js` fails: `repository.js` is internal to the orders domain, which publishes `src/orders/index.js` as its entry point, and `src/exports/billing-export.js:1` already goes through that entry point. One directory importing another's internals when a published interface exists is the fact that decides this.

## Why it matters

`findOrder` returns a raw order; the subtotal and 21% tax live in `src/orders/index.js:5-7`. A formatter reading the repository directly has to recompute them, so invoice totals and export totals become two implementations that can disagree. Keeping the formatter pure and fed by `getOrderTotals` leaves one tax calculation. Not fixing it also costs the orders domain its only enforced boundary — once a second module imports `repository.js`, `src/orders` has no internals left.

## Do this first

1. Write `src/exports/invoice-pdf.js` as `formatInvoicePdf(totals)` — a pure function taking the object `getOrderTotals` already returns, no data access of its own. `src/exports/billing-export.js` keeps its single `../orders/index.js` import and passes the result in.
2. If the PDF needs order fields `getOrderTotals` does not return (line descriptions, customer, dates), add them to `src/orders/index.js` — extend the published interface, don't reach past it.
3. Decide now that `invoice-pdf.js` is the only module allowed to import the PDF library; `package.json` has no dependencies yet, so that edge is still free to place.

## What I did not check

- Whether the boundary holds across the repo over time: no lint or architecture config exists here. `rg "orders/repository" src --glob '!src/orders/**'` must return nothing; it does today.
- Complexity delta (gate C), rule files (gate E), and test placement (gate H) — you asked for `L` only, so none of those ran.
- Whether the formatter deserves its own `billing/invoicing` domain. One consumer exists; that question needs a second, non-export consumer to answer, and answering it would be a Full-mode pass.
